# Innovative Commercial Strategies (ICS)

> Commercial real estate advisory and AI revenue systems for the South Shore of Massachusetts — one advisor who negotiates the building and builds the systems that make it produce. Based in Brockton, MA. Founded and run by Daniel Lawton, a licensed Massachusetts real estate salesperson (#9082020) and hands-on operator who has built and run real businesses — which is why every system is measured in booked work, for any local business: trades, restaurants, salons, medical, legal, retail, and more.

Phone: (508) 942-8259. Email: lawtondj@gmail.com. In-person service across Brockton, Abington, Whitman, Bridgewater, West Bridgewater, East Bridgewater, Stoughton, Easton, Middleborough, and Plympton.

## Services

- [Commercial Real Estate Advisory](https://icsgroup.ai/commercial-real-estate/): buyer, seller, tenant, and landlord representation for sub-$3M owner-user and investment property; every listing marketed with offering memoranda, drone media, targeted campaigns, and property-level SEO.
- [AI Revenue Systems](https://icsgroup.ai/ai-services/): three fixed-scope systems with published pricing — JobSite ($6,500–$9,500 setup, conversion website live in 21 days guaranteed), Lead Engine ($12,000–$18,000, every lead answered in under 60 seconds 24/7), and Market Lock ($20,000–$30,000, territory-exclusive: one business per category per market).
- [Published pricing](https://icsgroup.ai/pricing/) and [written guarantees](https://icsgroup.ai/guarantees/): 21-day launch or $1,000/week credit; sub-60-second lead response; measurable 90-day improvement or ICS works free; clients own all code, accounts, and data.

## Free tools

- [QuoteBrain 2.0](https://icsgroup.ai/quotebrain/): instant-quote engines built for any service business — customers price their own job in 60 seconds. Live pavement-maintenance demo on the page; client installs are built around each business's own services and rates.
- [AI Readiness Score](https://icsgroup.ai/ai-readiness/): ten-question assessment scoring lead response, reputation, automation, and search visibility, with a 90-day action plan.
- [What's My Building Worth?](https://icsgroup.ai/building-worth/): free Broker Opinion of Value — walked in person, built on real comparables, written within 48 hours.
